title: HLSClaw: Bringing Vibe Coding to High-Level Synthesis through Skill-Based Agentic Harness
title_zh: HLSClaw：通过基于技能的智能体框架将氛围编程引入高层次综合

paragraphs.en: HLSClaw是基于技能的LLM智能体HLS优化框架，实现39.12倍时延加速并超越商用编码智能体。 LLM agents are rapidly shifting software development toward intent-driven \emph{vibe coding}, yet their effectiveness drops sharply in high-level synthesis (HLS), where code optimization must jointly consider design structure, directive search, and downstream hardware constraints. Existing HLS optimization approaches, including both heuristic-based methods and recent LLM-assisted pipelines, typically operate at fixed abstraction levels or in weakly coupled stages, limiting their ability to leverage the strong interplay between source code restructuring and directive search outcomes. Our key insight is that HLS optimization can be reframed from a fixed, hardwired transformation pipeline into a skill-based agentic control problem: an LLM agent equipped with modular, executable optimization skills and a feedback-driven orchestrator can autonomously navigate the coupled space of code restructuring and directive search. This motivates the design of HLSClaw, the first HLS-specific, skill-based agentic harness for holistic HLS optimization. On real-world HLS benchmarks, HLSClaw achieves a 39.12x geometric-mean latency speedup, outperforming the compiler baseline ScaleHLS by 1.98x, and surpassing the commercial coding agents Claude Code and Codex by 1.86x and 1.70x, respectively, while maintaining strong timing robustness.
paragraphs.zh: HLSClaw是基于技能的LLM智能体HLS优化框架，实现39.12倍时延加速并超越商用编码智能体。LLM智能体正迅速将软件开发推向以意图为中心的\emph{氛围编程}（vibe coding），然而其有效性在高级综合（HLS）中急剧下降，因为代码优化必须同时考虑设计结构、指令搜索以及下游硬件约束。 现有的HLS优化方法，包括基于启发式的方法和近期的LLM辅助流水线，通常在固定的抽象层级或弱耦合的阶段中运行，限制了它们利用源代码重构与指令搜索结果之间强相互作用的能力。 我们的关键洞察是，HLS优化可以从固定的、硬编码的变换流水线重新构建为一个基于技能的智能体控制问题：配备模块化、可执行优化技能以及反馈驱动编排器的LLM智能体，能够自主地在代码重构与指令搜索的耦合空间中导航。 这促使我们设计HLSClaw，这是首个面向HLS的、基于技能的智能体框架，用于整体式HLS优化。 在真实世界的HLS基准上，HLSClaw实现了39.12倍的几何平均时延加速，比编译器基线ScaleHLS快1.98倍，并分别超越商用编码智能体Claude Code和Codex 1.86倍和1.70倍，同时保持了较强的时序鲁棒性。
